actions.action: Make presets optional, inspectable starting points
actions.mechanism: Separate preset application from custom editing so existing combinations never change through automatic role matching.
actions.implementation: Document each preset’s permissions. Retain all 18 controls under keyboard-operable groups. Applying a preset shows a difference preview requiring confirmation.
actions.check: Load and save every existing custom role; assert identical permission values. Editing one toggle must not reapply a preset.
actions.risk: Preset documentation can drift; generate it from permission definitions.

actions.action: Preview what this teammate can actually do
actions.mechanism: Calculated effective permissions expose consequential capabilities that individual toggle states may obscure.
actions.implementation: Show a live “Can / Cannot” summary, prominently including draft review, publishing, and billing. Explain differences from selected toggles when calculation data permits.
actions.check: For representative custom combinations, compare every summary statement with calculated permissions. Verify updates are discoverable by keyboard and screen reader.
actions.risk: Unexplained results must remain visibly unresolved, not receive guessed explanations.

actions.action: Require deliberate selection of sensitive privileges
actions.mechanism: Publishing and billing cannot enter an invitation solely through presets, copied roles, or inherited defaults.
actions.implementation: Require unchecked, owner-operated confirmations whenever calculated access includes publishing or billing. Invalidate confirmation when its relevant configuration changes; preserve the custom combination.
actions.check: Apply each privilege-granting preset and copied role; sending must remain blocked until the owner explicitly confirms each sensitive privilege using keyboard controls.
actions.risk: Broad confirmations can hide scope; name the exact privileges.

actions.action: Check intended access against the final invitation
actions.mechanism: Independent capability expectations detect contradictions rather than silently correcting ambiguous permission choices.
actions.implementation: Let owners specify required and forbidden capabilities. Before sending, recalculate the exact submitted configuration; block mismatches with keyboard-linked controls for explicit resolution.
actions.check: Require draft review and forbid publishing; inject a publishing-granting toggle after preview. Assert a mismatch appears and no invitation is sent.
actions.risk: Expectations can be mistaken; permit deliberate edits without silently rewriting permissions.
